import gzip,hashlib,json
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone
root=Path.cwd();out=root/'evaluation/evidence/reviews/a2-cli-20261107'

commands=json.loads((out/'commands.json').read_text())
assert len(commands)==6
for row in commands:
 assert row['exitCode']==0 and not row['timedOut'],row
 log=root/row['log'];packed=log.read_bytes()
 assert sha(packed)==row['compressedSha256']
 assert sha(gzip.decompress(packed))==row['outputSha256']
 assert json.loads((out/(log.name.removesuffix('.gz')+'.process.json')).read_text())['status']=='STOPPED'
before=json.loads((out/'inputs-before.json').read_text());after=json.loads((out/'inputs-after.json').read_text())
assert after['unchangedSourceEntries']==len(before['sourcePins'])==892
for p,d in before['sourcePins'].items():assert sha((root/'evaluation/runs/a2-cli-20261107/snapshot'/p).read_bytes())==d,p
for p,d in before['localInputs'].items():assert sha((root/p).read_bytes())==d,p
for p,d in before['helperPins'].items():assert sha((out/p).read_bytes())==d,p
assert after['immutable']==before['immutable']
assert '317 passed' in gzip.decompress((out/'focused.txt.gz').read_bytes()).decode()
assert 'exports match 9 files' in gzip.decompress((out/'default-export.txt.gz').read_bytes()).decode()
probe=json.loads((out/'probe-results.json').read_text())
assert probe['count']==25 and set(probe['startupDiagnosticGaps'])=={'overflowing numeric chainId','schema JSON array'}
assert all(not r['stateCreated'] for r in probe['controls'] if 'stateCreated' in r)
peers=json.loads((out/'communication-final.json').read_text())
assert len(peers['files'])==388 and peers['branches']['origin/agent-2']==before['a2Tip']
assert not peers['missingBranches'] and not any(r['ambiguous'] or r['divergentRevisions'] for r in peers['files'].values())

assert all(r['concurrentAcquisitionRefused'] for r in locks['locks'].values())
result=dict(recordedAt=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),predecessorCommandsVerified=len(commands),focusedTests=317,defaultExports=9,independentProbeCases=25,expectedDiagnosticGaps=probe['startupDiagnosticGaps'],sourceEntriesStable=892,localInputsStable=len(before['localInputs']),helperInputsStable=len(before['helperPins']),historicalEEntries=before['historicalEEntries'],historicalEChanged=before['historicalEChanged'],communicationPaths=388,immutable=after['immutable'],completeRuntimeReady=False,executionAuthorized=False,gateF='NOT_RUN')
target=out/'verification.json';assert not target.exists();target.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+chr(10))
print(json.dumps(result,indent=2));print('verificationSha256='+sha(target.read_bytes()))
